summary: QT Imaging Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 1,200,000 shares of common stock and pre-funded warrants for 800,000 shares at a public offering price of $5.00 per share, raising approximately $10 million. The pre-funded warrants are exercisable immediately at $0.0001 per share. The closing price on May 14, 2026 was $6.72. Ladenburg Thalmann and Northland Capital Markets are underwriters. Delivery is expected May 18, 2026. This is a routine capital raise through an underwritten public offering, not a special situation event.
